---
title: "Player"
toc: false
---

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="player.css">
<style>
/* player.css is tuned for a reveal.js slide, where everything scales with the
   deck. This is an ordinary page, so the component is given a base size of its
   own -- and the clock the size the thing is named for. */
.btp { font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 1.5rem 0 3rem; }
.btp .btp-clock { font-size: clamp(3.5rem, 15vw, 9rem); }
.btp .btp-stage,
.btp .btp-drop,
.btp .btp-bar { max-width: 900px; }
</style>

<div class="btp">
  <div class="btp-clock idle">00:00</div>
  <div class="btp-stage" hidden></div>
  <div class="btp-drop">Drop a video file here</div>
  <div class="btp-bar">
    <input class="btp-url" type="text" placeholder="Paste a YouTube link…" spellcheck="false">
    <button class="btp-load">Load</button>
    <label class="btp-filebtn">Choose file<input class="btp-file" type="file" accept="video/*"></label>
  </div>
  <div class="btp-err"></div>
</div>

<script src="player.js"></script>
```
